timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Decides when your day starts and ends for due dates and habits.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.help: Everything you've entered, in one file that Life OS can restore — here or into a new account. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup.notJson: That file isn't a backup file (expected a .json file downloaded from Life OS).
backup.checked: The file is complete and undamaged, and a test restore succeeded. Nothing has been changed yet.
backup.lostHelp: After restoring, your data will be exactly what's in the backup.
backup.warnReplace_one: {{count}} current record will be removed or overwritten by older versions.
backup.warnReplace_other: {{count}} current records will be removed or overwritten by older versions.
backup.warnReplaceSame: Your current data will be replaced by the backup (it currently matches).
backup.understand: I understand my current data will be replaced
backup.tip: Tip: download a backup of your current data first if you might want it back.
backup.pdfHelp: Your goals, tasks, habits, schedule, journal and weekly reviews, laid out to read, print or share. It can't be restored from.
backup.reportsHelp: A PDF of today, this week or this month so far: tasks done, focus, habits, goals, time and journal. Older ones are on the Reports page.

sound.label: Sounds & haptics
sound.help: Soft clicks, a chime when you finish a task or habit, and a bell when a focus session ends. Saved on this device.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.help: Notifications from Life OS while it's open — in a browser tab, or the installed app on a computer. On a phone they arrive while the app is open. Saved on this device.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then switch this on again.
reminders.review: Weekly review (last day of your week)
reminders.testBody: This is how Life OS will remind you.

blocked.insecure: Notifications need a secure address. This page was opened over plain http:// (for example a computer's network address on your phone), so the browser won't allow them. Open Life OS at its https:// address, or on the computer itself at localhost.
blocked.install-ios: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work in the installed app: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen", open Life OS from the new icon and switch this on there.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.avatarHelp: Shown in your greeting and the sidebar. Tap it again to remove.

academia.title: Academia
academia.body: A scholar’s study: leather-bound libraries or cream parchment, serif headings and an oxblood seal.
academia.on: Academia is on. Pick a scene below: the first three are dark, the last two light.
academia.accentNote: Academia uses its own ink and brass colours.

password.title: Change password
password.help: At least {{min}} characters. Your other devices will be signed out.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
